log.headline: Rebuilt a staff Mac's printer queue remotely
log.detail: The queue pointed at a retired print server, so I removed it and reinstalled it from Self Service without a visit.

log.headline: Swapped a broken student Chromebook for a loaner
log.detail: Logged the damage, assigned a loaner in Google Admin, and queued the original for repair.

log.headline: Cleared a stuck Jamf Connect sign-in
log.detail: Reset the user's login keychain so the sign-in window stopped coming back, and linked it to the open problem record.
